experiment.ba_formula: BA(D) = Phi(<Delta,D> / (2 ||D||)) for test x = +/-Delta/2 + N(0,I), midpoint threshold (exact)
experiment.misra_gries_parts: positive part max(Delta_hat,0), negative part max(-Delta_hat,0); k = S/2 counters each
